items.title: Wire visual regression capture into Product Board visual_review phase

Failures route through fail-review → fix → retest

items.title: Install/document Playwright path or explicit non-use for visual testing
acceptanceCriteria: Either Playwright is available with a Product Board command, or inventory remains honest that it is missing
No claim of Playwright coverage without executable proof

items.title: Attestation workflow for Subscriber Ready policy criteria
acceptanceCriteria: board.mjs supports recording role attestations for required policy criteria
Gate can reach SUBSCRIBER_READY only with attestations + passing required commands + empty P0–P2 queue
items.notes: Foundation evaluates policy criteria as manual_required so we never fake approval.
